# My People

> The contacts hub of The Plan Beyond — manage trusted people, trustees, keyholders, and your Beyond Circle in one calm, secure place.

## Overview

My People is the relationship-management surface of a legacy-planning product. Users add contacts, mark trustees and emergency contacts, group people, and control who belongs to their "Beyond Circle" (the people notified as part of their plan).

## Key flows

- Add a contact (name + phone, country-code aware)
- Search, filter (groups, Beyond Circle, emergency, relationship), and sort contacts
- Open a contact to edit personal, address, and professional details
- Import contacts from Google or a VCF file

## Notes

This is a demo build with a mock API. No real personal data is stored.
